title: Red Eclipse in Desert
description: A surreal desert landscape features a massive red planet with a glowing corona and horizontal golden ring dominating the dark teal sky. Winding pink ethereal ribbons flow across the scene above a barren red-orange terrain with a dirt road leading toward distant red mountains, while a weathered road sign with a red X stands in the foreground.
